channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbusinessAndMarket, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Elon Musk outlines SpaceX plan for lunar manufacturing site
item.description: SpaceX SEC filings describe lunar satellite factories, electromagnetic launchers, and robotic mineral mining. Founders building space equipment are taking note.

item.title: Climate change turns Cape Cod into tiger shark habitat
item.description: Warming waters and abundant food are drawing tiger sharks to the region, researchers say.

item.title: U.S. offers $25 million reward for new CJNG leader
item.description: Washington increased the bounty for Juan Carlos 'Pelón' González, who allegedly took over the cartel after 'El Mencho' was killed.

item.title: Heat alerts across Italy as drought affects Hungary's nuclear plant
item.description: Low Danube water levels hinder reactor cooling, prompting Hungary to ration power while Italy issues red alerts for all major cities.
